summary: 已完成本题独立英文静态打字竞赛，可实际完成六篇文章；计时、匹配前缀WPM、保留错误输入分母的准确率、固定幽灵进度、暂停恢复、结果及本地纪录均已验证。

assertions: Pure scoring, entry-denominator accuracy, Unicode prefix and malformed storage
Only target static directory served at the final public subpath
Desktop initial no horizontal overflow
1440px no horizontal overflow
Default Medium, honest empty records and desktop cockpit
Real wall-clock starts on first printable key; mismatch lock, Backspace and lasting 66.7% accuracy
Manual pause/resume and simulated visibility-loss event exclude elapsed time and ghost motion
Paste/drop rejected; destructive restart requires confirmation and resets all metrics
Desktop after gameplay no horizontal overflow
Controlled browser-clock ghost formula, ghost-first continuation and exact full-passage finish
All six full original passages complete via native keyboard, including Hard numbers, punctuation and Unicode arrows
Desktop finished results no horizontal overflow
Result heading receives focus and copy contains actual metrics
Denied clipboard provides selected visible manual-copy field without false sharing success
Actual result PNG download is 1200×630 with a brand/difficulty/WPM filename
Race again repeats the passage; result Next passage cycles it; restart also works while paused
Twelve real completed test runs retain ten newest with per-difficulty bests, sequence labels and reload persistence
Confirmed history clear removes records and bests; first click preserves them
Mobile initial no horizontal overflow
Every visible mobile link, button and passage focus target is at least 44×44
Mobile finished results and history no horizontal overflow
390×844 touch-native typing, mismatch repair, actual completed result and 44px result controls
Unavailable localStorage keeps completed scores for the current page session
Malformed persisted data safely recovers to honest empty records
tests.evidence: 实际原生键盘及触摸仿真输入；正常墙钟检查与明确冻结/推进浏览器时钟的长赛程边界检查并用。覆盖三个固定幽灵速度、六篇完整文章、Unicode符号、错误锁定及退格修复、暂停/恢复、模拟visibilitychange、带确认重启、真实PNG下载、剪贴板拒绝后手动复制、最多十条持久纪录及确认清空、存储不可用/损坏。测试分数仅来自私有自动输入过程，不冒充人类成绩，也未预置到首页。

visual.assessment: 已逐一打开最终桌面、移动端、真实下载卡片、移动完成页及新首页预览。青/珊瑚配色层级明确，等宽正文清晰，赛道与控制台对齐。移动端采用168px画布，保留三列统计和原生输入，开始按钮完整出现在844px首屏；所有可见触摸入口至少44×44，无横向溢出。
resolvedFindings: 初版移动开始按钮低于首屏，已调整换篇入口和正文内部滚动区并实际复测。
快速完成后GO短暂残留已修复，完成时立即清空倒计时。
品牌和页脚链接已补足44px移动触摸高度。

limitations: 按本轮授权采用不构建的HTML/CSS/原生浏览器模块静态适配，不宣称交付Vite 5/React 18应用或严格TypeScript构建。
src\content.ts及src\scoring.ts为可直接在浏览器使用的JavaScript兼容TypeScript源，分别逐字复制为浏览器模块；仅必需静态文件进入out。
移动输入由Chromium触摸与键盘仿真验证，未声称在实体手机上验证系统软键盘。
隐藏标签暂停通过模拟document.hidden及visibilitychange事件验证，未声称执行实体设备后台切换。
本地纪录只在当前浏览器及来源保存；Echo为固定目标速度，不是真人或联网对手。
原始需求及默认文章保留VibeFather署名和CC BY-NC 4.0非商业限制；字体与图标分别保留OFL/ISC/MIT许可证。
发布配置仅通过现有登记函数新增默认关闭的未部署选项；该函数未为新prompt分配共享分类，实际category为null。
resourceNote: 全部本题QA浏览器及预览服务器均已在finally关闭；协调器已持有的37596串行锁辅助进程未动。
